# data.docker_compose_logs

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads the logs of a compose project's containers, like `docker compose logs --timestamps`. Each container's last `tail` lines are read, merged in time order into `log_entries` (source `<service>.<container>`) and rendered as `logs`.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `container_ids` | `map(list(string))` | computed |  |  | Map of service name to the IDs of its selected containers, in container-number order. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of logs. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version of the daemon. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon. |
| `log_entries` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | One entry per log line in arrival order, read with timestamps=true and bounded by the tail/since inputs; `source` is "<compose service>.<container name>". Only `message` is sensitive (log lines can print secrets). |
| `logs` | `string` | computed |  | yes | The log entries as plain text, one line per entry: "<timestamp> <stream> <source> <message>". Sensitive: log lines can print secrets. |
| `name` | `string` | required |  |  | The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`). |
| `services` | `list(string)` | optional |  |  | Only these services (default: every service of the project). |
| `since` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only lines at or after this time. Takes an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. `2026-01-02T15:04:05Z`) or a duration before now such as `42m` or `1h30m`, sent as the Engine's UNIX-timestamp `since`. Combined with `tail` when both are set. |
| `tail` | `number` | optional |  |  | Lines to keep from the end of the logs of each container, service or task (the Engine's `tail`). Default `1000`, so state cannot grow without bound; `0` reads none, and there is no "all". |

### `log_entries`

nested attribute, list(object). One entry per log line in arrival order, read with timestamps=true and bounded by the tail/since inputs; `source` is "<compose service>.<container name>". Only `message` is sensitive (log lines can print secrets).

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | `string` | computed |  | yes | Upstream `log line without the timestamp prefix and trailing newline`. Sensitive. |
| `source` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Labels[com.docker.compose.service] + "." + Names[0] (leading "/" removed)`. |
| `stream` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `multiplexed frame header stream type: 1 = stdout, 2 = stderr; a TTY stream is not multiplexed (the Engine merges stdout and stderr at the source), so it is "combined"`. |
| `timestamp` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `timestamps=true line prefix (RFC 3339 nano)`. |

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_compose_logs" "shop" {
  name     = "shop"
  services = ["web"]
  tail     = 100
  since    = "15m"
}

output "web_errors" {
  value     = [for e in data.docker_compose_logs.shop.log_entries : e.message if e.stream == "stderr"]
  sensitive = true
}
```
